legal.translated: This is a translation for convenience. In case of differences, the English version applies:
info.how.intro: There is no online payment on the website. You send a request, and the owner contacts you personally.
info.how.step1: Choose toys and add them to the cart. If you want just one, use “{quick}” on the product page.
info.how.step2: In the cart, enter your name and a convenient way to contact you, then send the request. It is free and does not oblige you to buy.
info.how.step3: The owner contacts you during {hours} (Warsaw time) and confirms availability, the total, delivery and how to pay.
info.how.step4: You pay the owner directly in the agreed way, and the owner ships the parcel.
info.delivery.text1: We ship from Wrocław (Poland) across Europe and to Ukraine.
info.delivery.text2: The owner agrees the delivery method and cost with you personally. Delivery is paid by the buyer, and you learn its cost before you agree to buy.
info.delivery.payText1: There is no online payment on the website, and it never asks for your card details. You pay the owner directly in the way agreed when they contact you.
info.delivery.payText2: Prices are in {base}. Prices in other currencies are approximate.
info.delivery.returnsText: You have 14 days to return the goods without giving a reason.
info.contact.fastest: Fastest: send a request from the cart or a product page — the owner will contact you the way you choose.
